changelog: Update channel: the release package now ships database/migrations and auto-update.sh applies them, so schema changes reach remote installs instead of being silently skipped. Previously the tarball carried only the built code and version.json.

Hardening: if the customer tables are missing (an install that never ran migration 002), customer scope resolution now denies all access and logs why, instead of returning a 500 on every request. It fails closed — a broken schema can never widen a read-only account's visibility.
Includes 3.2.105: user roles are scoped to customers (issue #21). Non-admin accounts are read-only and see only the endpoints of the customers they are assigned to.
